Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
Urine analysis shows significant leukocyturia, bacteriuria, positive nitrites, and presence of Klebsiella pneumoniae (>100,000 CFU/mL), indicating a urinary tract infection. Low specific gravity may suggest dilute urine. Mild hematuria and proteinuria are present. No ketones or casts detected. Recommend clinical correlation and appropriate antibiotic therapy.
